title: Farside run_once integration test
instructions: Add only one pytest test file for the existing FarsideEtfCollector live runner integration. Use a fixed HTML fixture with 14 Aug 2026 Total (56.2) and 17 Aug 2026 Total 137.3. Patch runner.FarsideEtfCollector.collect to call FarsideEtfCollector.parse_html with the passed clock; patch all other eight runner default collectors to return []. With temporary local_dir call runner.run_once(network=True, include_backfill=False, as_of_ms=1787054400000). 1787054400000 is 18 Aug 2026 12:00 UTC; 17 Aug 2026 midnight is 1786924800000. Assert farside_etf collection_attempt OK with observation_count 1, source_errors empty, appended_observations 1, archive_records_loaded 1, scoring_records_loaded 1. Read result['paths']['archive'] using load_observations; assert one ETF net_flow_usd source farside_btc_etf value 137.3 unit USD_MILLIONS, effective clock 1786924800000, available/observed clocks 1787054400000, revision '1787054400000'. Assert result['anata_output']['families']['etf']['scoring_observation_count']==1 and ['context_observation_count']==0, scoring_latest_effective_at_ms 1786924800000. Assert result['anata_output']['source_evidence'] contains ETF farside_btc_etf role scoring with correct three clocks and revision. Assert result['anata_output']['evidence_health']['collection']['successful_collectors'] includes farside_etf and ['families']['etf'] scoring_observation_count 1, scoring_latest_effective_at_ms 1786924800000, scoring_latest_available_at_ms 1787054400000, scoring_effective_age_seconds 129600.0, scoring_availability_age_seconds 0.0. Read audit_latest JSON from result['paths']['audit_latest'] and assert audit['context_only_observation_count']==0. IMPORTANT: anata_output has NO top-level context_only_observation_count; do not access it. Do not change production files or weaken point-in-time, context/scoring separation, scoring-only freshness or revision identity. Do not require non-null scores from one row.
